hook.name: NexsetsHook
hook.description: Token-launch fee hook that withholds ETH fees from buys and sells via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Applies a cycling 1–5% tax schedule for both directions, a 60% anti-snipe tax during a 4-second post-launch window (with an owner-controlled whitelist), an admin-controlled special sell-tax override (up to 60%), and enforces a one-time LP seed lock. All fees route 100% to treasury.
